verdict.rationale: Datalab documents concrete rate limits (400 req/min on Team plan), a page_range parameter for splitting oversized documents, checkpointing to avoid re-parsing, and an Enterprise/on-prem tier explicitly aimed at 'extremely high volume' workloads. However, there's no explicit documentation of batch/bulk-submission APIs, queueing behavior, or throughput benchmarks for processing millions of pages. Missing for 10: dedicated bulk/batch ingestion API docs, published pages-per-minute throughput numbers, and guidance/backpressure handling for million-page scale jobs.
